Typo – Please note two corrections here: 1) the accent has been added for the joy of Andhrabharati; 2) the final letter has been corrected.

Typo – I understand that the letter "b" and "v" may be interchanged at times, but in this case, there appears to be no supporting evidence. I am an "Old School Purest". Substituting the letter "b" for the letter "v" is simply to accomodate Barbarians who are incapable of proper pronunciation. I do not approve of such "dialects" which simply degrade the purity of Sanskrit.
